newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-CBA cuts fixed mortgage rates.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-CBA cuts fixed mortgage rates.

text.p: The Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CBA) said on Friday it had reduced its mortgage rates fixed for two to five years by up to 0.55 percentage points.

The bank said it reduced its two year fixed mortgage rate to 8.5 percent from 8.75 percent, its three year rate to 8.70 percent from 8.95 percent, its four year rate to 8.95 percent from 9.5 percent and its five year rate to 8.95 percent from 9.5 percent.
The bank said the rates applied to owner occupied as well as investment home loan borrowers.
The new loan rates would be effective from September 2.
